technique_name: Compare and contrast an object-oriented programming language with a procedural programming language
description: Object-oriented programming languages and procedural programming languages differ in terms of the fundamentals of programming. Object-oriented programming languages prioritize objects over functions while procedural programming languages prioritize functions over objects. Also, object-oriented programming is based on the concept of inheritance where classes in the same hierarchy can inherit methods and variables, whereas procedural programming does not have the concept of inheritance.
